newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks turn lower on EMU delay fears.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks turn lower on EMU delay fears.

text.p: MADRID, June 9 (Reuter) 1130 GMT - Madrid stock indices turned suddenly lower on news that France needs more time to reflect on a stability pact, prompting fears that monetary union may be delayed, dealers said.

"The market is full of speculative money and is very sensitive to this type of news. Volatility is likely to continue to set the tone for the rest of this year, and any type of (EMU) comment like this will send the market lower, although the base of the market is still firm," said a dealer at a Spanish bank.
The Ibex-35 index of leading shares was down 20.53 points, 0.31 percent, to 6,595.62 after opening up around 1.3 percent.
